coverage.name: STM32F401RE Cortex-M4F / FreeRTOS
coverage.limit: Executes the ARM ELF; throughput is emulated, not a silicon benchmark.

coverage.name: MPU6050 at 0x68
coverage.limit: Digital register/driver behavior; no motion physics, drift or noise calibration.

coverage.name: BMP280 at 0x76
coverage.limit: Compensation and derived altitude; physical accuracy is not modeled.

coverage.name: I2C1 and sensor recovery
coverage.limit: Slave removal exercises NACK/timeouts; pull-ups, rise time and wiring require hardware.

coverage.name: GPIOA/B and RCC
coverage.limit: Used alternate-function registers only; no pin voltage or PLL-lock timing validation.

coverage.name: TIM2 / NVIC / SysTick / DWT
coverage.limit: Configured interrupts and counters; latency is emulator-dependent.

coverage.name: SRAM / task stacks / heap
coverage.limit: Checks live RTOS memory margins; not an exhaustive RAM or leak qualification.

coverage.name: Flash boot journal / UID
coverage.limit: Retained across MCU resets in a session; no wear, power-cut or journal-reclamation simulation.

coverage.name: USART2 / transport
coverage.limit: Model feeds a loopback TCP bridge; physical UART timing and USB cabling need hardware.

coverage.name: Independent watchdog
coverage.limit: Reset and recovery verified; RCC cause flags are not faithful in this model.

coverage.name: RTC / PWR / bit-band aliases
coverage.limit: Platform support dependencies; no application RTC, sleep or bit-band feature to exercise.

coverage.name: ADC / SPI / CAN / USB / user LED and button
coverage.limit: Not used by this hub firmware; no test or hardware-coverage claim.

cases.title: Boot and calibrated readings
cases.expected: Both sensors online; 25.08 C, 1006.53 hPa, [0,0,1] g, zero rotation; watchdog fed.
cases.method: Execute the ARM ELF and inspect validated firmware telemetry.

cases.title: Accelerometer XYZ
cases.expected: [0.5, -0.25, 0.75] g on all three axes.
cases.method: Set signed MPU6050 acceleration registers through Renode.

cases.title: Gyroscope XYZ
cases.expected: [5, -20, 10] degrees/second on all three axes.
cases.method: Set signed gyroscope registers and verify firmware scaling.

cases.title: IMU die temperature
cases.expected: Raw 3400 converts to 46.53 C.
cases.method: Change the MPU6050 temperature register independently of the BMP280.

cases.title: Signed IMU endpoints
cases.expected: Signed 16-bit endpoint conversion on acceleration and gyro, including zero.
cases.method: Inject -32768, 0 and 32767 and check each decoded axis.

cases.title: Barometer compensation
cases.expected: Raw temperature 530000 compensates to 28.25 C.
cases.method: Use the BMP280 calibration coefficients in the actual C driver.

cases.title: Pressure and derived altitude
cases.expected: 946.43 hPa and about 571.78 m; formula independently checked.
cases.method: Set pressure ADC value 450000 and verify firmware compensation and altitude.

cases.title: IMU disconnect and recovery
cases.expected: IMU null/offline; BMP280 remains valid; recovery without reboot.
cases.method: Unregister the MPU6050 peripheral, then attach a fresh model.

fault_observation.message: Verified: Disconnect MPU6050. Board degraded; boot 3.

cases.title: Barometer disconnect and recovery
cases.expected: Barometer null/offline; IMU remains valid; recovery without reboot.
cases.method: Unregister the BMP280 peripheral, then attach a fresh model.

fault_observation.message: Verified: Disconnect BMP280. Board degraded; boot 3.

cases.title: Both sensors disconnected
cases.expected: Both measurements unavailable; diagnostic frames continue; automatic recovery.
cases.method: Remove both I2C slaves, then reattach them.

fault_observation.message: Verified: Disconnect both sensors. Board degraded; boot 3.

cases.title: GPIO alternate functions
cases.expected: PB8/PB9 AF4 open drain; PA2/PA3 AF7; used GPIO modes configured.
cases.method: Read back GPIO mode, output-type and alternate-function registers.

cases.title: Peripheral clock enables
cases.expected: GPIOA/B, TIM2, USART2 and I2C1 clocks enabled by firmware.
cases.method: Read RCC enable bits; this does not measure oscillator accuracy.

cases.title: TIM2 and NVIC setup
cases.expected: TIM2 enabled, PSC 8399, ARR 99; interrupt 28 enabled.
cases.method: Read TIM2/NVIC registers and observe advancing sample sequences.

cases.title: SysTick and DWT
cases.expected: SysTick enabled with interrupt and 83999 reload; DWT cycle counter enabled and advancing.
cases.method: Read core timing registers around fresh firmware telemetry.

cases.title: Acquisition and telemetry cadence
cases.expected: About 100 samples and 10 frames per firmware second, with zero new queue drops.
cases.method: Compare sample, frame and uptime deltas over at least 2 firmware seconds.

cases.title: RTOS heap and task stacks
cases.expected: Positive free heap and nonzero high-water marks for all four tasks.
cases.method: Resolve ELF symbols and read FreeRTOS diagnostics from emulated SRAM.

checks.name: FreeRTOS heap
checks.expected: positive current and minimum free bytes

cases.title: Boot journal contents
cases.expected: Committed journal magic with complementary boot words; UID is mapped and stable.
cases.method: Read flash journal and UID memory; no destructive flash writes.

cases.title: MCU reset and boot identity
cases.expected: Same device ID, boot +1, sequence and uptime restart; watchdog health resumes.
cases.method: Issue a machine reset; inspect the next firmware session.

checks.name: Fresh session healthy
checks.expected: low uptime, sequence and fed watchdog

cases.title: UART configuration and reconnect
cases.expected: USART2 TX/RX enabled, 115200-baud divider configured; bridge reconnects, boot unchanged.
cases.method: Read UART registers, disconnect the loopback UART bridge, and verify new telemetry.

cases.title: Independent watchdog recovery
cases.expected: Stalled acquisition triggers a new boot and healthy telemetry.
cases.method: Disable TIM2; let the modeled hardware IWDG reset the MCU.

checks.name: Fresh session healthy
checks.expected: low uptime, sequence and fed watchdog

cases.title: WebSocket snapshot and updates
cases.expected: A new client receives a snapshot followed by validated live telemetry.
cases.method: Connect to the actual gateway WebSocket endpoint.

cases.title: 30 second stability check
cases.expected: Stable boot, free heap and bounded queues; frames continue with no new decode/order/drop errors.
cases.method: Observe 30 seconds of wall time and compare heap, stacks and gateway counters.
